title: Australia Terror Attack Suspect
body: Israeli officials suspect Iran behind the deadly assault on a Jewish Chanukah gathering in Sydney, with intelligence assessments pointing to the country as the primary suspect.

title: Australia's Hanukkah Beach Attack
body: US Ambassador Mike Huckabee criticizes Australian PM Anthony Albanese for what he sees as an inadequate response to the deadly Bondi Beach attack that killed at least 12 people during a Hanukkah celebration.
